statement: For an algebraizable positive-characteristic strict-local germ with regular projective resolution and one smooth connected exceptional Cartier divisor with ample conormal, rational top Chow restricts isomorphically to CH0 of the exceptional divisor and the ordinary top quotient of the puncture vanishes
depends_on: KST TheoremA; GH TheoremA; TT8.1; rational Chern character; Bertini; fixed p-power entire-curve-family lifting; GAGA; Popescu; henselian smooth lifting
notes: No retraction assumed. Single smooth divisor and ample conormal hypotheses retained. Full root and real_weil audits pass. No SNC or arbitrary singularity claim; focused literature comparison recorded without a priority claim.
